details: Bernstein analysts predict Bitcoin (BTC) could reach $125,000 by December 2026, while Michaël van de Poppe anticipates a new all-time high by January 2027. Bitcoin recently experienced $241 million in net inflows into US spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) over the last week, marking the third consecutive week of positive inflows. This bullish sentiment is further supported by the formation of a "golden cross" technical pattern in Bitcoin's chart, a signal that has historically preceded significant gains. Currently, Bitcoin is trading around $86,093 and is facing resistance at the 2026 yearly open of $87,570. Market dynamics show a cluster of short positions above $88,000, which could trigger a short squeeze if breached, potentially fueling a further rally.
title: Bitcoin Price Targets Point to Significant Upside Despite Current Resistance

details: Ethereum (ETH) surged by nearly 70% in Q3 2026, outperforming Bitcoin's 42% gain, largely driven by $3.1 billion in net inflows into US spot ETH ETFs. This strong performance, however, is coupled with concerns about thinning market depth, suggesting that large trades could lead to increased price volatility. Furthermore, Ethereum's supply has turned inflationary, with approximately 2,600 new ETH minted daily by validators and the burn rate lagging due to reduced Layer 2 fees following the Dencun upgrade. Despite this, institutional interest remains, with companies like Bitmine Immersion Technologies actively accumulating ETH, having acquired 15,112 ETH last week to bring their total holdings to over 6 million tokens.
title: Ethereum Sees Strong Q3 Gains but Faces Inflationary Concerns

details: The Solana Foundation has launched Solana DvP, an open-source escrow program designed to facilitate delivery-versus-payment (DvP) settlement for financial institutions on the Solana blockchain. Developed with input from J.P. Morgan, this initiative aims to provide institutional clients with the settlement certainty and atomic settlement capabilities required for large-scale operations, utilizing Solana's high performance. This development is seen as a significant step towards broader institutional adoption of the Solana ecosystem. Meanwhile, Solana's SOL token is trading around $121.44, consolidating below a key resistance zone between $122.49 and $123.53, with traders anticipating a decisive breakout. Standard Chartered has set an ambitious price target of $250 for Solana by December 2026, though the token has shown limited movement towards this goal since the forecast was made months ago.
title: Solana Boosts Institutional Appeal with DvP Settlement Program

details: In the United States, regulatory bodies are actively working to establish clearer frameworks for crypto assets. CFTC Chairman Michael Selig announced the agency is proposing its first formal crypto-market rules, termed "Regulation CTX" (crypto asset transactions) and "Regulation CAM" (crypto asset markets), following the Senate's failure to advance the Clarity Act. Concurrently, the SEC staff has issued Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) to guide market participants on how federal securities laws apply to certain crypto assets and transactions. These initiatives reflect ongoing efforts to provide greater regulatory clarity and encourage innovation within the US digital asset market.
title: US Regulators Move to Clarify Crypto Rules
